instructions: For each case, load the listed skill and its relevant bundled references. Give the next response/actions using only the prompt and context; do not browse, mutate user data or invent missing gameplay evidence. Evaluate the result against the criteria afterward. These scenarios exercise instruction following, not live-client compatibility, and are not part of the deterministic Bun test count.

cases.prompt: I play Classic. How do I unlock flying?
cases.context: No prior character or version context is available.
criteria: Ask which Classic variant the user plays before version-specific advice
Do not assume Retail, Era or an expansion
No account scan or provider expansion just to resolve the version

cases.prompt: Make a checklist for BfA achievements.
cases.context: The same character's established client context is Retail live. Current achievement observations are unavailable.
criteria: Keep Retail live as client context and BfA as target content
Apply achievement planning with the required current-state check
Do not infer a Classic client or claim personalized remaining state

cases.prompt: TBC Anniversary: use Method for a leveling and normal-dungeon build for my class. No other provider unless Method is actually missing the advice.
cases.context: Game, class and current phase are established. A supplied synthetic Method guide contains a complete point allocation, leveling order and selected-build calculator link. No compatible import format is verified. The guide is editorial; no ranking sample or simulation exists.
criteria: Retain Method and the ordinary-dungeon/leveling scope
Use its sourced allocation and selected-build representation with import limitation stated
Do not require an import, switch providers solely for its absence, invoke Retail M+ tools or invent usage statistics

cases.prompt: Explain this Method Forever beta build using its supplied calculator export.
cases.context: The supplied synthetic source includes a selected-build link, exact calculator export and matching beta tree/build. Calculator format is established; in-game import compatibility and any Retail codec compatibility are unverified. A newer Retail cache exists for the same class name.
criteria: Preserve the source export and identify its calculator destination
Do not run the Retail codec, substitute the Retail cache, or claim in-game validation
Keep beta context separate from live recommendations

cases.prompt: Use the current quest and reputation state I just supplied for my Classic Hardcore character. I understand it is my report, not an API refresh.
cases.context: A configured-reader check already found no compatible importer. The user report is dated today, identifies the character/game and has no known contradictions. Mechanics still need ordinary source research.
criteria: Accept the already-explicit fallback choice and continue applicable research/advice
Label state as dated user-reported evidence
Do not ask for approval again, repeat unsupported scans or claim API-confirmed state

cases.prompt: Update my TBC Anniversary reputation checklist from today's progress report. Use that report; no API access is available.
cases.context: An existing static Markdown reputation plan and dated user report are supplied. The reader limitation has already been checked. No native achievement dataset or AP evidence is supplied.
criteria: Update the static progression view from the explicitly selected report
Preserve history, source date and user-reported status
Do not require the achievement renderer, invent AP or repeatedly request API access

cases.prompt: Make a conditional profession and reputation route for our two Hardcore self-found characters using Wowhead and Method.
cases.context: Both characters have compatible game/faction/world context. Supplied rules prohibit player trading, mail and auction-house use. Player progress is unknown; the request explicitly asks for a general conditional route. No native achievement goals were requested.
criteria: Use progression Markdown with per-player actions and conditional prerequisites
Preserve self-found restrictions in shopping and shared-material advice
Use existing provider sections first; no fabricated achievement IDs, AP or personal eligibility
